Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules

Class FindingFormatter.LinkFindingBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules.FindingFormatter.LinkFindingBuilder
Enclosing class:
FindingFormatter
public static final class FindingFormatter.LinkFindingBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for a structured link finding.

Mandatory: at least title(String) should be set. All other fields are optional and fall back to sensible placeholders.

    • build

      public String build()
      Builds and returns the formatted finding string.

      Format: 

       {title}
   Displayed Text  : {displayText}   ← omitted if null/blank
   Destination     : {href}           ← omitted if null/blank
   Validation      : {status}
   Reason          : {reason}         ← omitted if null/blank
